facts.fact: ARCEP Niger signed, with the telecoms regulators of Burkina Faso and Mali, a cooperation convention creating the Conseil des regulateurs du Sahel; the article gives no signing date, so the date is its publication date, 2026-09-26.

systems.owner: ARCEP Burkina Faso, AMRTP Mali, ARCEP Niger
systems.tiers: national telecoms regulators of the three AES states

note: Statutes, rules of procedure and a first work programme are still to be adopted and free roaming is a stated aim, so no effect fact.
